rule: A beats B iff the 95% percentile bootstrap CI of the paired difference excludes 0 in A's favour for BOTH information gain (nats/event) AND PR-AUC; otherwise the pair is inseparable.

bootstrap.block: Politis-Romano stationary bootstrap over ordered window-ids (all 1219 cells per window kept together)
bootstrap.note: windows tile at 30-day steps; targets non-overlapping but temporally dependent via shared feature history + aftershock clustering -> block (not iid) resampling required.
